text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The long summer training camp was finally coming to an end—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I seeee~☆
Mayano, you're entering the Kikuka Sho, right?★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yeah! The training camp might be over, but once we get back to the academy, I can't just space out!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'll win the race where the strongest Umamusume wins!
Maya's definitely gonna get stronger!
And then--

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'll give you a race that'll make Brian-san
blaze with pure passion!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ooohhh☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: No, if I'm gonna do it—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I'll show you a back that makes it impossible to look away from Maya's sparkle, just like that!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Oo-oo-oooh~~~☆★☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: It's still a bit difficult for me to enter races yet, but next year, I'm definitely aiming for graded stakes.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: "I really pushed myself hard this summer, and I feel like I've gotten my body into great shape!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Fufu. It looks like both of us had a really great training camp♪

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You're so right!! This is truly,
Summer MARVELOOOUS☆★☆!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The bus ride was long. Combined with the fatigue from the camp itself, many girls were exhausted upon returning to the academy, but Marvelous Sunday remained as energetic as ever.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Trainer!
Both Mayano and Laurel were amazing, weren't they☆
They were burning with passion and totally ripped★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! I'm slowly getting
more muscular, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I nod firmly. During the summer training camp,
she had run just as hard as any of her rivals.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Challenge Cup, her primary goal, is still some ways offâ
but before then, she might be able to overcome her physical issues.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay!!
We did it, we did it, we did it!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"This is also Summer Marvelous!!
It's all thanks to you, Trainer☆"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna get way, way more buff!
Super-duper buff, you'll see!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Let's do our best☆
Marveeelooous★☆★
